systems.tiers: planned to connect states, local government areas and wards

note: The Secretary to the Government of the Federation's representative said (31 Aug 2026) the government plans about 90,000 km of fibre under Project Bridge to connect states, local government areas and wards: a planned backbone reaching the areas, with no local government office said to be on it. The 774 local government areas are otherwise the spread of a skills programme's registrants. No fact.
